verdict.rationale: Otter documents audit trails, logging and admin activity logs, which give admins some visibility into account activity, and Channels provide team or project shared spaces. However, there is no evidence of granular link, folder or workspace permission controls. Community users concretely report that Otter shares transcripts with every meeting participant by default, the opposite of private-by-default; the vendor never claims private-by-default, so this lowers quality rather than making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: private-by-default notes (reported default is share-with-all), granular link/folder/workspace permission controls, admin reporting specifically on what is shared, independent corroboration of the admin logging.
